description: Read who gets the monthly invoice email for a business. Every paid invoice is always emailed to the business owner (returned masked); up to 3 extra addresses, such as a bookkeeper or office inbox, get the same email. Mirrors GET /api/v1/billing-contacts.

business_id.description: Business ID (optional only when the token can access exactly one business).

name: get_billing_contacts

owner_email.description: The owner's login email, masked. The owner always gets every invoice.

title: Get Invoice Email Recipients
